description: This file contains implementation of functions related to the ConfUi messaging and state management within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, including conversions between message types and FSM states, as well as string representations of states.

methods.name: ToFsmInput
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiMessage to an FSM input based on the message type.

methods.name: ToString(FsmInput)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FsmInput enum value.

methods.name: ToString(const MainLoopState&)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MainLoopState enum value.
